ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is likely the direct outcome of increased producers?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food/energy cycle diagram. The plant pile in the lower right is labeled "producers," the rabbit above is labeled "primary consumers," the animal on the left is labeled "secondary consumers," the mushrooms below are labeled "decomposers," and there is also "solar energy" on the right. From near "producers" there is an arrow pointing to the rabbit above, that is, pointing to "primary consumers." Reasoning: The question asks the direct result of an increase in "producers." Because in the figure producers are directly connected to primary consumers, and producers are the food/energy source of primary consumers, an increase in producers will directly support more primary consumers. Therefore the most likely direct result is an increase in primary consumers.
